title: 生计角色对话头像
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original anime upper-body dialogue portrait sheet for a serious Chinese JRPG.
Produce one square image organized as EXACTLY 3 equal rows by 3 equal columns, nine independent portraits on the same flat solid dark teal background. All nine depict the SAME adult woman protagonist, about 30, short brown bob haircut and a small teal hairclip, mature natural human proportions, consistent facial identity. Clean ink linework and flat shaded colors, high quality anime character illustration, NOT chibi, NOT pixel sprites, no childlike face, no caricature.
ROW 1: delivery worker, worn unbranded yellow rain jacket, hood down, brown bob and teal hairclip clearly visible, plain delivery backpack straps visible at shoulders only.
ROW 2: factory worker, faded blue industrial coverall, matching plain blue work cap, brown bob and small teal hairclip visible below cap, no white coat.
ROW 3: street survival, worn charcoal gray jacket, slightly unkempt short brown bob and small teal hairclip, dignified ordinary adult face.
Within EVERY row: column 1 tired neutral calm expression; column 2 arguing/angry expression with tense eyebrows and open mouth; column 3 withdrawn, hurt and sad expression, eyes downcast, shoulders slightly drawn inward.
Composition: each cell must independently contain one complete head with hair/cap, neck and shoulders, upper torso down to mid chest. Generous consistent dark teal padding above every head and between all portraits. Align face scale and framing across all nine. Heads, shoulders, clothing and hands must never cross cell boundaries. No drawn panel lines or borders. No text, words, labels, numbers, logos, brand marks, UI, watermark, furniture, scenery, speech bubbles or props extending into neighboring cells. Exact 3 by 3 layout with all nine heads clearly visible.
